title: The repeat mark skips a same-thread follow-up and marks only a restated, already-answered ask
why: Owner 14:24 CST Nov 12 (via retrospective): "damn that false repeat mark triggers far too often jesus". Measured in the retrospective today: 35 marks, about 14 false (about 40%), mostly a follow-up to the message just before it on the same topic.
source: owner 14:24 CST Nov 12, relayed by the retrospective 14:25 CST
note: Fix in hooks/feedback_guard.py: the judge skips candidates from the same thread within the last 30 minutes, and marks only an ask that restates an older, already-answered one. Red first on today's false pairs: fb-1419-4 vs 14:16 CST, fb-1422-2 vs 14:19 CST (retrospective inbox). Rule verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent. Runs at every Stop for every session that logs the owner's words: rank with the stability fixes. Kin: repeat-judge-never-blocks (doing, lane prose-unmapped-4).
